answer: A cable car operator licence with cabin inspection logs works as the gate: inspections passed on one line every year. Each of 328 aliases needs its own inspection logs, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The falcon check runs in the open: 328 fakes pay the full price 328 times, one honest agent pays once, and the anchor trail in the ledger makes the relic cost visible to everyone.
